title_en: Zavateri to Stand at Tally-Ho Stud in 2027
description: Group 1 winner Zavateri will make his last appearance in the Queen Elizabeth II Stakes (G1) Oct. 17 at Ascot Racecourse before retiring to stand at Tally-Ho Stud for the 2027 breeding season.

title_en: Mr Percy Prevails in Jonathan Sheppard Memorial
description: Shannon Hill Farm's Mr Percy prevails narrowly to land his first top-level stakes victory in the Sept. 2 Jonathan Sheppard Memorial (NSA-1), a 2 3/8-mile steeplechase handicap for older horses at Saratoga Race Course.

title_en: Glacius Eyes Another American Prize in Nashville Derby
description: Glacius showed a natural liking for American turf by winning the Saratoga Derby Stakes (G1T) Aug. 8 by 1 1/4 lengths. He returns in the $3 million Nashville Derby Invitational Stakes (G2T), the richest turf race for 3-year-olds in the U.S.

description: Kentucky Downs has partnered with Gulfstream Park and 1/ST Bet on the Gulfstream Summer Sweep Pick 5, a unique Pick 5 sequence on both Sept. 5-6, featuring action at Kentucky Downs and Gulfstream Park.

title_en: Gulfstream Park Begins Sunshine Meet Sept. 4
description: The Sunshine Meet at Gulfstream Park, a precursor to the Championship Meet, begins Sept. 4 with a nine-race program and a stakes schedule highlighted by the $225,000 Princess Rooney Stakes (G3).

title_en: Burnham Square Enters Kentucky Turf Cup on a Roll
description: In a race that figures to provide more clues on how Burnham Square measures up against top international runners, he'll face face Breeders' Cup Turf winner Ethical Diamond in the deepest edition to date of the Kentucky Turf Cup Invitational Stakes.

title_en: From the Magazine: Unveiling of New Belmont Park
description: The reconstruction, costing more than $500 million, includes the revamping of the main track and two turf courses and the addition of an all-weather surface. Read more about this new era in the September 2026 issue of BloodHorse magazine.

title_en: Outside Post for Supercharger in Old Dominion Derby
description: C R K Stable's Supercharger will try to add to an already breakthrough meeting at Colonial Downs, and strong 3-year-old season overall, when the Constitution colt faces an expected 13 other sophomores in the $500,000 Old Dominion Derby (G3T) Sept. 7.

title_en: Louisiana Yearling Sale Triples 2025 Gross
description: For the first time, Breeders Sales of Louisiana split its annual sale into a live preferred yearling sale in September, to be followed next month by a digital mixed sale. A total of 121 yearlings changed hands for a gross of $2,580,200.

description: Peter Lau Pak Fai's Hong Kong superstar Romantic Warrior, who won 15 times at the highest level, has been retired due to a leg injury.

title_en: Franco Dominates Saratoga, Earns Jockey of the Week
description: Manny Franco's 11 wins during the week of Aug. 24-30 earned him Jockey of the Week honors. His wins were highlighted by victories in the West Point Stakes, Travers Stakes (G1), and Yaddo Stakes.

description: Trainer Ricky Hendriks is well-suited with a pair of contenders in grade 1-winner Little Trilby and grade 1-placed Coutach for the Sept. 2 Jonathan Sheppard Memorial, a 2 3/8-mile steeplechase handicap for older horses, at Saratoga Race Course.

description: The Pennsylvania Thoroughbred Horsemen's Association and Parx Racing are proud to partner with Stable Recovery for the inaugural running of the Stable Recovery Stakes on Pennsylvania Derby day Sept. 19.
